name: Noisy / Diverse-Speaker ASR Collapse (Calibration)
description: Calibration recipe for the S02 noisy / diverse-speaker ASR family. Identical pipeline to T30-C but expects a noisier audio corpus (e.g. librispeech_other, commonvoice_en) where more segments fall into the 'ambiguous' and 'noisy' confidence bins. The student head trained here learns the harder decision boundary between borderline-clear and escalation-worthy segments. Use with speech_pack.sh --domain librispeech_other --family S02.
